ai_summary: AceVector Limited has officially updated its Corporate Identity Number (CIN) from an 'Unlisted' ('U') to a 'Listed' ('L') designation, reflecting its recent listing on the National Stock Exchange of India and Bombay Stock Exchange on October 5, 2026. This administrative change, alongside the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) updating its listing status to "Yes," formally confirms the company's transition to a publicly traded entity and represents a routine post-listing regulatory compliance, with no apparent red flags.
